challenges.says: The second and third criteria (open on double-click or Enter, nothing happens when nothing is chosen) cite no rule and do not say in their wording that they come from the screen's actions rather than a stated rule.

The why and journey step 1 promise finding support rules by the product a person cares about, but no cited rule or criterion filters or lists rules by product coverage, only by name, so that promise is not backed by any rule.
